rejection_summary: X the Unknown (1956, tt0049967): strong scientist-led radiation investigation and meaningful deduction, but the whole film ultimately centers on a radioactive creature threat and containment/destruction; concept escalation and rule discovery are not strong enough to support the 82-point acceptance threshold.

Timeslip / The Atomic Man (1955): intriguing time-displacement mystery with nuclear-science context, but investigation is driven primarily by reporters and pivots into industrial espionage; scientific investigation and discoverable-system depth are too limited for an 82+ match.

Frozen Alive (1964, tt0058084): suspended-animation research is a real scientific premise, but the feature shifts heavily into murder suspicion and interpersonal drama rather than sustained investigation, escalating consequences, or discovery of an impossible rule set.
